## Read in scevan results
```{r other_meth_compile_scevan}
read_tsv(
  list.files(
    "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scevan_results",
    pattern = "_scevan_results.tsv",
    full.names = TRUE
  ),
  id = "sample",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    sample = str_remove(sample, "_scevan_results.tsv") %>%
      str_remove(".+/")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    scevan_call = class,
    cell = barcode
  ) %>%
  select(-confidentNormal) %>%
  write_tsv(
    "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scevan_results/compiled_scevan_output.tsv"
  )
```

## Read in numbat results
```{r other_meth_compile_numbat}
numbat_files <- list.files(
  path = "output/10_cmp_other_methods/numbat_results/rdata",
  pattern = "^clone_post_2.tsv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

numbat_results <- tibble(sample = character())
for (this_file in numbat_files) {
  numbat_results <-
    read_tsv(
      this_file,
      id = "sample",
      show_col_types = FALSE,
      col_select = c(cell, sample, compartment_opt)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      sample = str_remove(sample, ".+rdata/") %>%
        str_remove("/output/clone_post_2.tsv")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(numbat_call = compartment_opt) %>%
    bind_rows(numbat_results)
}

write_tsv(
  numbat_results,
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/numbat_results/compiled_numbat_output.tsv"
)

rm(numbat_results, numbat_files)
```

## Merge all the human outputs together
```{r other_meth_compile_compile}
#| dependson: [other_meth_compile_scevan, other_meth_compile_scatomic, other_meth_compile_numbat, other_meth_compile_copykat, other_meth_compile_infercna, other_meth_compile_scanbit]
call_files <- c(
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scevan_results/compiled_scevan_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scatomic_results/compiled_scatomic_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/numbat_results/compiled_numbat_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/copykat_results/compiled_copykat_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/infercna_results/compiled_infercna_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scanbit_results/snv_tumor_calls.txt"
)

all_calls <-
  lapply(call_files, function(x) read_tsv(x, show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  purrr::reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = c("cell", "sample"))) %>%
  mutate(
    scevan_call = str_replace(scevan_call, "normal", "Normal") %>%
      str_replace("tumor", "Tumor") %>%
      str_replace("filtered", "Unassigned") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned"),
    scatomic_call = str_replace(scatomic_call, "Cancer", "Tumor") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned"),
    numbat_call = str_replace(numbat_call, "normal", "Normal") %>%
      str_replace("tumor", "Tumor") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned"),
    copykat_call = str_replace(copykat_call, "aneuploid", "Tumor") %>%
      str_replace("diploid", "Normal") %>%
      str_replace("not.defined", "Unassigned") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned"),
    infercna_call = str_replace(infercna_call, "nonmalignant", "Normal") %>%
      str_replace("malignant", "Tumor") %>%
      str_replace("unassigned", "Unassigned") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned"),
    scanBit_call = str_replace(scanBit_call, "normal", "Normal") %>%
      str_replace("tumor", "Tumor") %>%
      str_replace("unknown", "Unassigned") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned")
  )

write_tsv(
  all_calls,
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/all_calls.tsv"
)
```

## Make pdfs of dimplots for all samples to show all methods
```{r other_meth_plot_human_dimplots}
#| dependson: [other_meth_plot_human]
human_calls <- read_tsv("output/10_cmp_other_methods/human_calls.tsv")

human_sample_metadata <- read_tsv(
  "misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

human_samples <-
  human_sample_metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(align_ref == "/home/gdrobertslab/lab/GenRef/10x-hg38") %>%
  pull("Sample_ID") %>%
  unique()

title_key <- list(
  "scevan_call" = "SCEVAN",
  "scatomic_call" = "SCATOMIC",
  "numbat_call" = "Numbat",
  "copykat_call" = "CopyKAT",
  "infercna_call" = "InferCNA",
  "scanBit_call" = "ScanBit",
  "cell_type" = "Cell Type"
)

color_key <- list(
  "Normal" = plot_cols[2],
  "Tumor" = plot_cols[1],
  "Unassigned" = plot_cols[5],
  "top_lvl_group0" = plot_cols[4],
  "top_lvl_group1" = plot_cols[3]
)

for (this_sample in human_samples) {
  message("Processing sample: ", this_sample)

  this_metadata <-
    human_sample_metadata %>%
    dplyr::filter(Sample_ID == this_sample)

  sobj <- qs_read(
    paste0(
      "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
      this_sample,
      "_human.qs2"
    )
  ) %>%
    AddMetaData(
      human_calls %>%
        dplyr::filter(sample == this_sample) %>%
        column_to_rownames("cell") %>%
        dplyr::select(
          -sample,
          -sample_group,
          -tumor_type,
          -n_cells,
          -pattern_id,
          -cell_order
        )
    )

  image_list <-
    lapply(
      c(
        "scevan_call",
        "scatomic_call",
        "numbat_call",
        "copykat_call",
        "infercna_call",
        "scanBit_call",
        "cell_type"
      ),
      function(x) {
        use_colors <- color_key[names(color_key) %in% sobj@meta.data[[x]]]
        plot_obj <- DimPlot(
          sobj,
          group.by = x,
          repel = TRUE,
          pt.size = 0.5
        ) +
          labs(title = title_key[[x]]) +
          theme(
            legend.position = "bottom",
            axis.text.x = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
            axis.text.y = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
          )

        if (x != "cell_type") {
          plot_obj <- plot_obj + scale_color_manual(values = use_colors)
        } else {
          plot_obj <-
            LabelClusters(plot_obj, id = "cell_type", box = TRUE) +
            theme(legend.position = "none")
        }

        return(plot_obj)
      }
    )

  plot_layout <- "
    ABC
    DEF
    GGG
    GGG
  "

  ggsave(
    file = paste0(
      "output/10_cmp_other_methods/figures/dimplots/",
      this_sample,
      ".pdf"
    ),
    plot = patchwork::wrap_plots(image_list, design = plot_layout) +
      plot_annotation(
        title = "Tumor Identification Method Comparison",
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Sample: ",
          this_sample,
          ": ",
          this_metadata$description[1]
        )
      ),
    width = 10,
    height = 15
  )
  rm(sobj, image_list)
}
```

## Compare results for known mouse tumors
```{r other_meth_plot_transgene}
#| dependson: [other_meth_compile_compile]
min_transgene_prop <- 0.2

tumor_ids <-
  bind_rows(
    read_tsv(
      "output/07_known_tumors/snv/transgene/transgene_tumor_clust_ltbc.txt",
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ),
    read_tsv(
      "output/07_known_tumors/snv/transgene/transgene_tumor_clust.txt",
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tumor_cell = replace_na(tumor_cell, "no_transgene") %>%
      str_replace("Has transgene", "has_transgene")
  ) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = tumor_cell,
    values_from = proportion,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    actual_state = if_else(
      has_transgene >= min_transgene_prop,
      "Tumor",
      "Normal"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Sample_ID, cell_group, actual_state) %>%
  dplyr::rename(cluster_label = cell_group, sample = Sample_ID)

sample_cluster_table <-
  lapply(
    unique(tumor_ids$sample),
    function(x) {
      qs_read(paste0(
        "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
        x,
        "_mouse.qs2"
      )) %>%
        .[[]] %>%
        select(cell_barcode, cluster_label, individ_clusters, Sample_ID)
    }
  ) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(cluster_label = paste0(cluster_label, "_c", individ_clusters)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    cell = cell_barcode,
    sample = Sample_ID
  ) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  left_join(tumor_ids, by = c("sample", "cluster_label")) %>%
  select(sample, cell, actual_state)

mouse_samples <-
  tumor_ids$sample %>%
  unique()

mouse_calls <-
  read_tsv(
    "output/10_cmp_other_methods/all_calls.tsv",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
  filter(sample %in% mouse_samples) %>%
  full_join(sample_cluster_table, by = c("sample", "cell")) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  order_cells(
    call_cols = c(
      "actual_state",
      "scevan_call",
      "copykat_call",
      "infercna_call",
      "scanBit_call"
    )
  )

alternate_method_known_plot <-
  mouse_calls %>%
  select(-scatomic_call, -numbat_call) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ends_with("_call"), "actual_state"),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "call"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = recode(
      method,
      "scevan_call" = "SCEVAN",
      "copykat_call" = "CopyKAT",
      "infercna_call" = "InferCNA",
      "scanBit_call" = "ScanBit",
      "actual_state" = "Actual State"
    ) %>%
      factor(
        levels = c("SCEVAN", "CopyKAT", "InferCNA", "ScanBit", "Actual State")
      )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = cell_order,
      y = method,
      fill = call
    )
  ) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_key) +
  facet_grid(
    ~sample,
    scales = "free_x",
    space = "fixed"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Cells",
    y = "Method",
    fill = "Cell type",
    title = "Tumor Cell Identification in Samples with Known Tumor States"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 8,
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "output/10_cmp_other_methods/figures/alternate_method_call_plot_known_tumors.pdf",
  plot = alternate_method_known_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6
)
```

## Interrater reliability
```{r other_meth_irr}
human_calls <- read_tsv(
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/human_calls.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
colnames(human_calls) <- recode(
      colnames(human_calls),
      "scevan_call" = "SCEVAN",
      "copykat_call" = "CopyKAT",
      "infercna_call" = "InferCNA",
      "scanBit_call" = "ScanBit",
      "actual_state" = "Actual State",
      "scatomic_call" = "SCATOMIC",
      "numbat_call" = "Numbat"
    )

combinations <-
  c("SCEVAN", "CopyKAT", "InferCNA", "ScanBit", "SCATOMIC", "Numbat") %>%
  combn(2, simplify = FALSE)

all_irr <- lapply(
  combinations,
  function(this_combination) {
    this_combination <- sort(this_combination)
    out <- tibble(
      method1 = this_combination[1],
      method2 = this_combination[2],
      irr = irr::agree(human_calls %>% select(all_of(this_combination)))$value
    )

    return(out)
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()

ggsave(
  filename = "output/10_cmp_other_methods/figures/irr_heatmap.pdf",
  plot = ggplot(
    all_irr,
    aes(
      x = method1,
      y = method2,
      fill = irr,
      label = round(irr, 2)
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(color = "black", size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "gray", high = "red") +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      fill = "Interrater\nreliability",
      title = "Interrater Reliability Between Orthogonal Methods"
    ),
  width = 6,
  height = 6
)


```
